errors.evidence: The description fails to mention the numerous text annotations on the plot that explain the reasons for the price fluctuations (e.g., '2010/11 Lieferkrise', 'Überangebot', 'Nachfrageerholung nach Einbruch durch COVID-19-Pandemie'). These annotations are crucial for understanding the context of the data.
The green line for 'Cer (Oxid)' peaks in 2011 at a value of approximately 80 US-Dollar/kg, not 150.
The line for 'Dysprosium (Oxid)' peaks in 2011 at a value of approximately 2,300–2,400 on the right y-axis, not 3,500–3,600.

The line for 'Lanthan (Oxid)' is the lightest blue/cyan line in the plot. Describing it as 'mittelblaue' (medium blue) is confusing, especially since the line for 'Praseodym (Oxid)' is a darker medium blue.
The line for 'Praseodym (Oxid)' is a medium blue. Describing it as 'sehr hellblaue' (very light blue) is inaccurate and confusing, as the 'Lanthan (Oxid)' line is visibly lighter.
